findings.message: Exact multiples add an extra empty page: Math.floor(total/pageSize)+1 always adds one page. Use a ceil-based formula or handle exact division. total=40/pageSize=20 returns 3.
Null input is dereferenced before any null check. A missing parser payload will crash at parser.js:24.
Consider adding more unit tests around parser error handling.
Cache key only includes user id, not tenant id. Two tenants can read each other's cached data, a cross-tenant leak.
Cache entries never expire because TTL is ignored.
